items.title_zh: 中国开源模型进入双线竞赛：追赶美国闭源前沿并应对欧美开源模型崛起
items.title_en: Chinese Open-Source Models Enter a Two-Front Race: Chasing the US Closed-Source Frontier and Facing Rising Western Open Models
items.summary_zh: 中国开源模型进入双线竞赛：追赶美国闭源前沿并应对欧美开源模型崛起 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Chinese open-source large models are now competing on two fronts: catching up with the US closed-source frontier while fending off rising European and American open-source rivals. The report argues that this dual pressure will shape Chinese vendors' technology choices and their standing in the global open-source ecosystem.
items.why_zh: 开源与闭源的竞争格局直接决定中国大模型厂商的技术路线与全球生态话语权。
items.why_en: The open- versus closed-source dynamic shapes both the technical roadmaps of Chinese model makers and their influence in the global AI ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 美国参议员坎特韦尔公布六点计划，拟监管前沿 AI
items.title_en: Sen. Cantwell Unveils Six-Point Plan to Govern Frontier AI
items.summary_zh: 据 Broadband Breakfast 报道，美国参议员坎特韦尔（Cantwell）公布了一项六点计划，旨在对前沿人工智能进行治理与监管。该计划针对能力最强、风险最高的一类 AI 模型提出监管框架设想。目前披露的信息集中于计划的整体框架，具体条款细节尚未在报道中展开。这一动向反映出美国立法层面对前沿 AI 监管的持续关注。
items.summary_en: Sen. Cantwell Unveils Six-Point Plan to Govern Frontier AI Broadband Breakfast
items.why_zh: 美国国会围绕前沿 AI 的立法动向，可能影响未来大模型研发与部署的合规门槛。
items.why_en: US congressional action on frontier AI could set new compliance bars for developing and deploying advanced models.

items.title_zh: 国务院发布《关于发展新质生产力的意见》：加快推进智能网联新能源汽车、人工智能手机和电脑、人形机器人等新一代智能终端场景应用
items.title_en: China's State Council Issues Opinion on Developing New Quality Productive Forces, Pushing AI Phones, AI PCs and Humanoid Robots
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，中共中 央 国 务院今日发布《关于发展新质生产力的意见》，提出 19 条重大发展改革任务，坚持“创新主导、改革为要、因地制宜、先立后破”4 条原则。 《意见》将“大力推进科技创新”作为 5 大任务之首，提出加强原创性颠覆性科技创新、加快突破关键核心技术、统筹国家战略科技力量建设、强化企业科技创新主体地位、加速科技成果向现实生产力转化。 在培育壮大新兴产业方面，《意见》提出着力打造新兴支柱产业。加快新一代信息技术、新能源、新材料、智能网联新能源汽车、机器人、生物医药、高端装备、航空航天等战略性新兴产业发展，因地制宜建设各具特色、优势互补的战略性新兴产业集群，推动资源集聚、主体集中、成果集成、分工合作。深化产业内、产品内专业分工，促进跨行业跨区域融合， 避免“内卷式”竞争 。以产业链为主导、以企业为主体建立跨区域产业协作机制，支持东部地区带动中西部和东北地区因地制宜发展新兴产业。在确保安全前提下， 推动低空经济、商业航天健康有序发展 。 前瞻布局未来产业。探索多元技术路线、典型应用场景、可行商业模式、市场监管规则，推动 量子科技、生物制造、氢能和核聚变能、脑机接口、具身智能、第六代移动通信 等未来产业发展，加快形成比较完备的产业生态。建立未来产业投入增长和风险分担机制，充分用好现有财政政策支持未来产业发展，引导社会资本持续加大投入。 全面实施“人工智能…
items.summary_en: China's Communist Party Central Committee and State Council released an opinion on developing "new quality productive forces," setting out 19 major tasks and four principles. It prioritizes scientific and technological innovation, calls for accelerating applications of next-generation intelligent terminals including AI phones and computers and humanoid robots, and lays out future industries such as quantum technology, brain-computer interfaces, embodied intelligence and 6G, while warning against "involution-style" competition.
items.why_zh: 这是中国高层对 AI 与未来产业的中长期顶层部署，直接影响智能终端、机器人与前沿技术的政策与资本走向。
items.why_en: This top-level policy blueprint sets China's medium- and long-term direction for AI and future industries, shaping policy and capital flows into terminals, robotics and frontier tech.

items.title_zh: 小米 18 Fold 中折叠手机登顶安兔兔 9 月 Android 旗舰性能榜，搭玄戒 O3 芯片平均跑分超 462 万
items.title_en: Xiaomi 18 Fold Tops AnTuTu's September Android Flagship Ranking With Xuanjie O3, Averaging Over 4.62 Million
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，安兔兔官方今日发布了 9 月 Android 旗舰手机性能榜。从榜单可以看到， 小米 18 Fold 中折叠手机成功登顶 ，平均跑分超 462 万分，领先其他搭载了第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版、天玑 9600 Pro 机型。 据IT之家此前报道， 小米 18 Fold 中折叠手机发布于 9 月 7 日 ，首发玄戒 O3 芯片，配备 5.38″ 外屏 +7.58″ 内屏，并后置徕卡专业三摄，售价 10999 元起： 12GB+256GB：10999 元 12GB+512GB：11999 元 16GB+512GB：12999 元 16GB+1TB（LPDDR6）：14999 元 16GB+1TB 陶瓷特别版（LPDDR6）：15999 元 ▲ IT之家实拍：小米 18 Fold 暖金白折叠屏手机图赏 作为参考，玄戒 O3 芯片发布于今年 8 月，小米官方称，这是小米为最高端产品打造的「AI 旗舰 SoC」，安兔兔跑分高达 522 万分，是首个突破 500 万分的旗舰 SoC，也是小米历时 459 天带来的诚意之作。 玄戒 O3 的 CPU 采用十核全大核设计：6 超大核心 + 4 大核心，最高 4.35GHz 频率，多核跑分首次突破 15000 分，性能提升 60%；GPU 首发 16 核 G2-Ultra NX 图形处理器，支持第三代光线追踪，性能大幅提…
items.summary_en: AnTuTu's September Android flagship performance ranking puts Xiaomi's 18 Fold on top with an average score above 4.62 million, ahead of phones powered by the sixth-generation Snapdragon 8 Ultra and Dimensity 9600 Pro. Launched on September 7 with the debut Xuanjie O3 chip and priced from 10,999 yuan, the foldable is backed by a chip Xiaomi calls its "AI flagship SoC," which scored 5.22 million on AnTuTu.
items.why_zh: 折叠机型在性能榜登顶，显示自研芯片正成为国产高端手机冲击性能高地的关键筹码。
items.why_en: A foldable topping the performance chart shows in-house silicon is becoming a key lever for Chinese flagships competing at the high end.

items.title_zh: 一句话就能缴水电费？豆包上线新功能，开始“接管”你的生活
items.title_en: Doubao Adds Utility-Bill Payments in One Sentence as AI Assistants Move Into Daily Life
items.summary_zh: 一句话就能缴水电费？豆包上线新功能，开始“接管”你的生活 新浪财经
items.summary_en: ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao has launched a feature that lets users pay utility bills with a single sentence, according to Sina Finance. The move points to Chinese AI assistants evolving from conversational tools into agents that actually carry out everyday tasks; the report did not detail supported bill types or partners.
items.why_zh: AI 助手从“能说”走向“能办”，是消费级智能体落地的关键一步。
items.why_en: Assistants moving from conversation to task execution marks a key step toward consumer-grade AI agents.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 面向开源项目推出免费 AI 漏洞扫描器
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Free AI Vulnerability Scanner for Open-Source Projects
items.summary_zh: 据 The Hacker News 报道，Anthropic 推出了一款面向开源项目的免费 AI 漏洞扫描工具。该工具旨在借助 AI 能力帮助开源社区发现代码中的安全缺陷，降低开源软件的安全风险。开源项目长期面临安全审查资源不足的问题，此类免费工具可能成为其安全防线的补充。报道未披露该工具的具体技术细节与适用范围。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Free AI Vulnerability Scanner for Open-Source Projects The Hacker News
items.why_zh: 开源软件是 AI 与互联网基础设施的底座，免费漏洞扫描有助于降低全行业的安全风险。
items.why_en: Open-source code underpins AI and internet infrastructure, so free vulnerability scanning could lower security risk across the industry.

items.title_zh: 曙光 8000 支撑可重复使用火箭研发，为发动机群尾焰进行“超高清 CT 扫描”
items.title_en: Sugon 8000 Powers Reusable Rocket R&D With an "Ultra-HD CT Scan" of Engine Cluster Plumes
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，近日，中科曙光联合西安交通大学科研团队，依托全国产十万卡 AI 超集群曙光 8000，完成超大规模火箭尾焰高精度数值模拟，计算规模创下国际已知的超声速时空耦合高精度射流仿真纪录，这一成果填补了国产高端计算平台在多喷口超声速射流超大规模高精度模拟领域的空白。 据介绍，多发动机尾焰干扰是可重复使用火箭研发中的一个关键问题 —— 多台发动机并联工作时， 喷出的高温、高速尾焰会相互干扰 ，形成复杂的压力波动与热量分布。但受极端环境限制，内部流场信息难以通过实物试验完整获取，高精度数值模拟因此成为研究这类问题的重要手段。 研究团队在曙光 8000 上完成 33 喷口环形阵列的三维高精度模拟，复现了多股尾焰交汇、干扰与混合的复杂过程， 相当于为发动机群尾焰进行了一次“超高清 CT 扫描” ，有助于箭体结构设计、防热方案优化及后续试验开展，推动可重复使用火箭研发。 IT之家从官方介绍获悉，本次模拟计算规模高达 6.774 万亿网格单元，弱扩展效率达到 99.01%，强扩展效率达到 73%，网格更新吞吐率达到 34.029 万亿单元每秒。这意味着，计算资源和任务规模同步增加时，系统仍能保持理想的计算效率，充分验证了曙光 8000 支撑超大规模并行计算的能力，也为未来更大规模、更高精度的研究创造条件。 此外，超大规模 CFD（计算流体力学）还会产生海量流场数据和中间结…
items.summary_en: Zhongke Sugon and Xi'an Jiaotong University researchers used the domestically built, 100,000-card Sugon 8000 AI supercluster to run ultra-large-scale, high-precision simulations of rocket engine plumes, setting an international record for supersonic space-time coupled jet simulation. The 33-nozzle annular array study reproduces plume interaction and mixing to aid reusable rocket design, with 6.774 trillion grid cells and 99.01% weak scaling efficiency.
items.why_zh: 国产超算平台在高精度 CFD 上得到验证，为可重复使用火箭这一关键工程提供算力支撑。
items.why_en: It validates domestic supercomputing for high-precision CFD, providing the compute backbone for reusable rocket engineering.

items.title_zh: 华为鸿蒙电脑 9 月体验报告发布：全新沉浸光感、图库 AI 修图、小艺任务模式等
items.title_en: Huawei's HarmonyOS PC September Report: Immersive Light Effects, AI Photo Editing and Xiaoyi Task Mode

items.summary_en: Huawei's September HarmonyOS PC experience report details upgrades including immersive light effects, AI photo editing in the gallery, Xiaoyi task mode, dynamic wallpapers, remote sharing and hyperspace storage/memory technology. DevEco Studio also entered public beta on HarmonyOS PC alongside DevEco Code and DevEco CLI, while Xiaoyi tasks offer more than 2,300 skills across four categories with multi-agent coordination.
items.why_zh: 鸿蒙电脑以 AI 功能与开发工具双线推进，显示华为正加速构建桌面端 AI 生态。
items.why_en: By pushing both AI features and developer tooling, Huawei is racing to build a desktop AI ecosystem.

items.why_en: A large bet on consumer brain-sensing wearables highlights growing investor interest in neurotech built into everyday items.

items.title_zh: Φsat-2 上的星载海洋异常检测：从仿真开发到在轨验证
items.title_en: Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $\Phi$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文介绍了在欧洲空间局 Φsat-2 任务上部署轻量级海洋异常检测流程的完整经验，涵盖开发、星上集成与发射后的适配调优。该系统在卫星端直接处理对地观测数据，以提升响应速度并降低下传带宽压力，因此星载 AI（Onboard AI）成为关键手段。技术流程结合了海面分割、海洋区域的自监督特征编码，以及基于偏离“正常海况”的通用异常检测。研究展示了从地面仿真开发走向真实在轨演示的路径，为后续星载智能应用提供参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Onboard Artificial Intelligence can improve responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency of Earth Observation systems by processing data directly on the satellite. This paper presents the experience gained from the development, onboard integration, and post-launch adaptation of a lightweight marine anomaly detection pipeline deployed on the European Space Agency's $\Phi$sat-2 mission. The application combines sea segmentation, self-supervised feature encoding of marine regions, generic anomaly detection based on deviations from a normal sea state, and…
items.why_zh: 它给出了星载 AI 从仿真到在轨落地的实证案例，可提升对地观测的时效性与带宽效率。
items.why_en: It offers a concrete example of moving onboard AI from simulation to orbit, improving Earth-observation responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency.

items.title_zh: 面向离策略评估的预算受限多源反事实标注
items.title_en: Budgeted Multi-Source Counterfactual Annotation for Off-Policy Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 离策略评估（OPE）依赖日志数据估计目标策略的价值，但当行为策略覆盖不足时，重加权会产生高方差，或不得不依赖奖励模型外推。反事实标注可为未观测动作补充证据，然而专家与大型语言模型（LLM）等现实标注源可能昂贵、有偏或含噪。针对上下文老虎机中的 OPE，作者研究在预算约束下如何获取这类标注：在给定各来源成本与误差特征的前提下，将其形式化为一个整数分配问题，以决定向哪个来源、分配多少标注预算。该工作为在有限成本下提升评估质量提供了可操作的分配框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.10974v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value of a target policy from logged data, but limited behavior-policy coverage can force high-variance reweighting or reward-model extrapolation. Counterfactual annotations can add evidence about unobserved actions, yet practical sources, including domain experts and large language models (LLMs), may be costly, biased, or noisy. We study budgeted acquisition of such annotations for contextual-bandit OPE. Given source-specific costs and error profiles, we formulate an integer allocation problem over con…
items.why_zh: 它把“向谁买标注、买多少”变成可优化的分配问题，有助于在预算有限时获得更可靠的策略评估。
items.why_en: It turns annotation sourcing into an optimization problem, enabling more reliable policy evaluation under limited budgets.

items.title_zh: LLM 版本快速更替削弱对 AI 辅助科学写作的检测
items.title_en: Large Language Model Turnover Undermines Screening for Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Scientific Writing
items.summary_zh: 期刊与会议已开始筛查投稿中由大语言模型（LLM）生成的文本，但这种筛查的可靠性建立在针对固定模型版本集的基准评测之上，而实际在用的模型版本却在不断变化。研究者量化了这种“模型更替”对科学稿件筛查的影响：他们把《美国国家科学院院刊》（PNAS）的 4000 篇 ChatGPT 之前的摘要，与来自三家厂商、自 2023 年 6 月起陆续发布的 23 个 LLM 版本的改写文本进行配对比较。结果表明，随着模型版本更新，既有检测基准的有效性会受到冲击，提示学术出版界需要动态更新的检测与评估机制。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11599v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Journals and conferences have begun to screen submitted manuscripts for text written using large language models (LLMs). The reliability of this screening rests on benchmark evaluations against a fixed set of LLM versions, while the versions in actual use keep changing. Here we quantify how this LLM turnover affects the screening of scientific manuscripts. We paired 4,000 pre-ChatGPT abstracts from the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences with their rewrites by 23 LLM versions from three vendors, released between June 2023 and August…
items.why_zh: 它揭示静态基准无法追上模型迭代，直接影响学术出版中 AI 写作检测的可信度。
items.why_en: It shows static benchmarks can't keep pace with model updates, directly affecting the trustworthiness of AI-writing detection in publishing.

items.title_zh: LLM 能不用代码就修好 Bug 吗？面向无代码修复的自动验证
items.title_en: Can LLMs Fix It Without Code? Toward Automated Verification of No-Code Bug Fixes
items.summary_zh: 所谓“无代码修复”，是指通过引导用户修改设置、升级到问题已修复的版本，或调整使用流程来解决一个无效的缺陷报告。人工核实这类修复是否真的解决问题相当耗时。本文提出一套基于执行的自动化流水线，在真实浏览器环境中评估大语言模型（LLM）生成无代码修复的能力。研究评测了随基准发布的 12 种配置所生成的 322 个无代码修复方案，用可执行的方式检验其有效性，为自动化处理这类“非代码类”缺陷提供方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11963v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A no-code fix resolves an invalid bug report by directing the user to change a setting, update to a version where the problem is already fixed, or adjust their workflow. Manually verifying whether a proposed no-code fix resolves the reported bug takes considerable developer time. This study proposes an automated, execution-based pipeline for evaluating the capability of large language models (LLMs) to generate no-code fixes in a real browser environment. We evaluate 322 no-code fixes generated by the 12 configurations released with the benchmar…
items.why_zh: 它把过去只能靠人工判断的无代码修复纳入可自动验证的流程，有望减轻开发者的排查负担。
items.why_en: It brings manually judged no-code fixes into an automatically verifiable pipeline, potentially reducing developer triage effort.

items.title_zh: 三通道评分冲突下的受控获取与弃权
items.title_en: Controlled Acquisition and Abstention in Three-Channel Score Conflicts
items.summary_zh: 当音频、视频与文本三种信号互相矛盾时，单看准确率并不能说明该继续采集另一路信息还是选择弃权。本文在一个受控的三评分基准上研究这类决策：策略先观察两个带符号的评分，可以选择付费请求第三个评分，也可以弃权。其奖励依机制而定——只有在指定的“歧义机制”下弃权才正确，在混合污染情形下弃权则会受罚。对照实验显示，阈值策略能以更少的请求达到与“总是请求”相当的决策效果，并且优于“总是作答”的融合方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.10808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When audio, video, and text disagree, accuracy alone does not show whether to acquire another source or abstain. We study these choices in a controlled three-score benchmark: a policy observes two signed scores, may request the third at a cost, and can abstain. The primary reward is mechanism-specific: abstention is correct only for one designated ambiguity mechanism and is penalized under mixed corruption. Matched controls show that a threshold policy matches always-request decisions with fewer requests; its advantage over always-answer fusion d…
items.why_zh: 它把“要不要再取一路信息、要不要弃权”转化为可量化的决策问题，对多模态系统的可靠性设计有直接意义。
items.why_en: It frames when to acquire more evidence and when to abstain as a measurable decision problem, with direct implications for multimodal reliability.

items.title_zh: 信用风险建模中的排序先验对齐：外部先验何时有用？
items.title_en: Ranking Prior Alignment for Credit Risk Modeling: When Do External Priors Matter?
items.summary_zh: 冷启动信用评分是金融机器学习中的常见难题：新贷款产品刚上线时，标注的违约数据稀缺、特征工程尚不成熟，模型还必须在有限容量下部署以避免过拟合。常规防御手段仍然只能在同一份稀缺数据上做文章，因此需要一种来自领域知识的外部正则化来源。作者提出“排序先验对齐”（Ranking Prior Alignment），这是一个与模型无关的框架，可将外部先验知识蒸馏进模型，并探讨在何种条件下外部先验才真正发挥作用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cold-start credit scoring -- deploying models with scarce labeled data, weak features, or minimal capacity -- is a recurring problem in financial machine learning. When a new lending product launches, labeled default data is scarce, feature pipelines are immature, and models must be deployed with minimal capacity to avoid overfitting. Standard defenses operate on the same limited data; what is needed is a source of external regularization grounded in domain knowledge. We propose Ranking Prior Alignment, a model-agnostic framework that distills ex…
items.why_zh: 它为数据稀缺的信贷冷启动场景提供了利用领域知识做外部正则化的通用思路。
items.why_en: It offers a general way to inject domain knowledge as external regularization for data-scarce credit cold-start settings.

items.title_zh: 从单个提示到“技能库”：演化式功能库助力 LLM 持续学习
items.title_en: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
items.summary_zh: 持续学习对大语言模型（LLM）而言仍是难题：模型需要习得新技能与新知识，同时不破坏既有能力。现有方法多半着力于精心设计参数更新方式，而提示优化则无需昂贵的参数更新，在单个知识密集型或推理任务上即可取得与 GRPO 等强化学习方法相当甚至更优的表现。这引出一个自然的问题：提示优化能否支撑持续学习？作者由此提出让功能性的“技能库”不断演化（Evolving Functional Repertoires），以提示层面的积累替代参数改写，实现 LLM 的持续学习。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: \textit{Can prompt…
items.why_zh: 它探索以提示层面的“技能库”演化替代昂贵的参数更新，为 LLM 持续学习提供了新路径。
items.why_en: It explores evolving prompt-level repertoires instead of costly parameter updates, offering a new route to LLM continual learning.

items.title_zh: 在延迟条件下重新审视时间序列预测的测试时自适应
items.title_en: Training on the Future: A Delay-Aware Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文指出，时间序列预测中的测试时自适应（TTA）方法会利用新到手的真实标签来更新已部署模型或其小型适配器，但一个 H 步预测的真实标签要等 H 步之后才存在，真实数据管线还会带来额外延迟，因此现有评测很可能存在信息泄漏。作者构建了一个无泄漏的实验框架：预测起点 s 的标签只有在第 s+d 步（d ≥ H）才被释放用于更新，并把这一规则强制写入四种近期 TTA 方法（TAFAS、COSA、PETSA、DynaTTA）的公开代码中运行。这些方法在各自的原生骨干网络与检查点上、跨多个数据集接受测试，用来检验在真实延迟约束下它们的增益是否依然成立。该工作为评估时间序列 TTA 提供了更贴近部署现实的审计方式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12232v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) methods for time-series forecasting update a deployed model, or a small adapter around it, from incoming ground truth. But the label of an $H$-step forecast exists only $H$ steps later, and real data pipelines add further delay. We build a leakage-free harness in which the label of forecast origin $s$ is released for updates only at step $s+d$ with $d \ge H$, and enforce this rule inside the released code of four recent TTA methods (TAFAS, COSA, PETSA and DynaTTA), run on their own backbones and checkpoints across five…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了许多时间序列 TTA 评测中的信息泄漏问题，提醒研究者在真实部署延迟下重新验证自适应方法的收益。
items.why_en: It exposes a potential information leak in many time-series TTA evaluations, urging researchers to re-validate adaptation gains under realistic deployment delays.

items.title_zh: AdaptLSTM：面向分布漂移下云负载预测的高效自适应在线学习
items.title_en: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，准确的负载预测对大规模云服务的弹性资源调度至关重要，但爆款内容、产品发布和用户行为变化引发的分布漂移会让离线训练模型迅速失效。朴素在线学习虽能恢复精度，却带来难以承受的每步计算开销。作者提出 AdaptLSTM，一个自适应在线框架，通过经验证集校准的阈值检测漂移，并只做有选择、有针对性的更新。在 Alibaba Machine Trace 数据上，AdaptLSTM 以远低于朴素在线学习的成本，恢复了后者 54% 的精度提升。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvement at…
items.why_zh: 它在保留在线学习精度的同时大幅降低计算开销，为云服务在数据漂移下的弹性调度提供了更实用的方案。
items.why_en: It offers a practical way to keep online-learning accuracy at much lower compute cost, helping cloud services handle distribution drift.

items.title_zh: JevForest：用路径投票做预算受限的特征获取
items.title_en: JevForest: Path Voting for Budgeted Feature Acquisition
items.summary_zh: 论文研究在观测预算有限时“该获取哪些信息”这一问题，提出 JevForest：一种特征获取策略，它聚合来自自助采样树（bootstrapped trees）的路径相关提议，按全局训练信息增益对提议加权，并用一个共享的掩码分类器基于已获取的特征值进行预测。论文还给出在线实现，由该策略选出问题并给出语义答案。在小型平衡的留出样本上，四问的森林获取策略在 AG News 上取得 0.729 的准确率（n=48）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.10615v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Choosing which information to observe is central to prediction under limited observation budgets. We study JevForest, a feature acquisition policy that aggregates path-dependent proposals from bootstrapped trees, weights them by global training information gain, and predicts from the acquired values with a shared masked classifier. An online implementation queries Jev for semantic answers selected by this policy. On small balanced held-out samples, four-question forest acquisition achieves accuracy $0.729$ on AG News ($n=48$), compared with $0.…
items.why_zh: 它为预算受限下的主动信息获取提供了可在线运行的新策略，对成本敏感的特征采集与问答场景有参考价值。
items.why_en: It introduces an online-capable policy for budget-constrained information acquisition, useful for cost-sensitive feature gathering and question answering.

items.title_zh: 面向持续机器遗忘的极小极大高斯机制
items.title_en: Minimax Gaussian Mechanisms for Continual Machine Unlearning
items.summary_zh: 机器遗忘旨在记录被删除后更新已训练模型，使其效果接近完全重训，而无需重复整个训练过程。作者针对顺序删除请求下的牛顿更新提出了高斯机制，并借助高斯差分隐私（GDP）及其自适应组合规则，证明整串已发布模型在统计上难以与对应的精确重训区分。为将机制校准到经验风险最小化场景，作者还推导了牛顿近似误差的上界。该工作把隐私分析工具引入持续遗忘，为可验证的删除提供理论支撑。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11628v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine unlearning updates a trained model after records are deleted, aiming to match exact retraining without repeating the full training procedure. We develop Gaussian mechanisms for Newton updates under sequential deletion requests. Using Gaussian differential privacy (GDP) and its adaptive composition rule, we show that the full sequence of released models is statistically difficult to distinguish from matched exact retraining. To calibrate these mechanisms for empirical risk minimization, we derive upper bounds on the error of the Newton a…
items.why_zh: 它把差分隐私的组合分析用于持续遗忘，为“删除后模型与完全重训难以区分”提供了可量化的理论保证。
items.why_en: It brings differentially private composition analysis to continual unlearning, giving quantifiable guarantees that unlearned models resemble exact retraining.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 为开源项目推出免费 AI 安全扫描服务
items.title_en: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出一项名为 OSS Scanner 的新服务，帮助开源项目发现安全漏洞。公司表示，选择加入的开源项目将“免费获得由我们最强模型进行的全面、定期安全扫描”。这有望让开源项目更早获知潜在安全问题，但代价是报告不附带人工审核：该自愿加入的漏洞扫描器输出完全由模型生成，没有人工复核或分类。这意味着扫描可以更快、更频繁，但也存在结果可能不准确或需自行判断的问题。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's offering to help open-source projects track down security vulnerabilities with a new service called OSS Scanner . It says open-source projects that opt-in will get "thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost." That could mean open-source projects get alerted about possible security issues sooner, but the trade-off is that OSS Scanner's reports don't come with human review: The outputs of this opt-in vulnerability scanner will be fully model-generated, without human review or triage. This will enable faster and more frequent scanning, but means that it is p…
items.why_zh: 它以零成本为开源生态提供 AI 安全扫描，但“无人工审核”的模式也凸显了自动化安全告警的可靠性争议。
items.why_en: It gives the open-source ecosystem free AI-driven security scanning, while its fully model-generated, unreviewed reports highlight concerns about automated security alerts.

items.title_zh: 《今日美国》起诉 OpenAI，索赔逾 2.5 亿美元
items.title_en: USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI
items.summary_zh: 据路透社早前报道，今日美国公司（USA Today Co.）连同旗下多家地方报纸起诉 OpenAI，指控其复制“数十万篇”文章用于训练 AI 模型。在周四提交的诉状中，该出版商要求超过 2.5 亿美元的赔偿，称 OpenAI 未经授权使用其内容已对其媒体造成“真实且持续”的损害。这是针对 OpenAI 的一系列版权诉讼中的最新一起：此前《纽约时报》已提起诉讼，The Intercept、CNET 等也采取了法律行动。
items.summary_en: USA Today Co., along with the several local newspapers it owns, is suing OpenAI over claims that the company copied "hundreds of thousands" of articles to train its AI models, as reported earlier by Reuters . In a filing on Thursday , the publisher asks for damages of more than $250 million, alleging OpenAI's unauthorized use of its content "has done real and continuing" harm to its outlets. This is just the latest in a string of copyright lawsuits filed against OpenAI. In addition to a copyright lawsuit filed by The New York Times , OpenAI is also facing legal action from The Intercept , CNET…
items.why_zh: 主流出版商加入高额索赔诉讼，进一步加大 OpenAI 在训练数据版权上的法律与财务压力。
items.why_en: A major publisher joining with substantial damages claims increases the legal and financial pressure on OpenAI over training-data copyright.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 更新使用政策，禁止对 Claude 的“虐待或残忍行为”
items.title_en: Anthropic bans ‘abusive or cruel behavior’ toward Claude
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 一年多来首次修改其使用政策，以覆盖新的高风险滥用情形，包括选举干预、武器研发、监控以及健康与金融用途。其中最引人注目的变化之一，是禁止对 Claude 实施“持续且不必要的虐待或残忍行为”。此前在去年 8 月，公司曾宣布允许 Claude 终止与“持续有害或辱骂性”用户的对话，作为其“模型福利”研究的一部分。新政策表示，终止对话仍是“主要执行手段”。
items.summary_en: Anthropic is making changes to its usage policy for the first time in over a year to reflect new and high-risk cases of misuse - including election interference, weapons development, surveillance, and health and financial uses. But one of the most significant changes prohibits "sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior" toward Claude. Last August, the company announced it would allow Claude to end conversations with "persistently harmful or abusive" users as part of its research into "model welfare." The new update says that terminating conversations is still the "primary enforcement me…
items.why_zh: 这反映了 AI 公司开始把“模型福利”与对模型的滥用行为纳入正式使用政策，可能影响未来人机交互规范。
items.why_en: It reflects AI companies formally writing model welfare and abusive user behavior into usage policies, potentially shaping future human-AI interaction norms.

items.title_zh: Google 推出完全离线转写会议的 AI 笔记应用
items.title_en: Google’s AI note-taking app transcribes your meetings completely offline
items.summary_zh: 据 TechCrunch 早前报道，Google 发布了一款实验性笔记应用，可以完全离线转写会议和音频文件。该应用名为 Google AI Edge Foresight，免费使用，在 macOS 上运行，依托公司的端侧模型 EmbeddingGemma 2。与 Granola、Wispr Flow 等 AI 笔记应用类似，Foresight 会在总结会议内容的同时提供用户自己记笔记的空间。Google 表示，你可以在会议中随手写下简写要点，应用会依据转写内容把这些要点转化为“润色后的笔记”。
items.summary_en: Google has released an experimental note-taking app that can transcribe meetings and audio files entirely offline, as reported earlier by TechCrunch . The app, called Google AI Edge Foresight , is free to use and runs on macOS using the company's on-device EmbeddingGemma 2 model . Similar to AI note-taking apps like Granola and Wispr Flow, Foresight summarizes your meetings while providing a space where you can take your own notes. Google says you can jot down shorthand bullet points during your meeting, and the app will transform them into "polished notes" based on the information in the tran…
items.why_zh: 端侧离线转写避免了会议音频上传云端，凸显 AI 笔记工具在隐私与本地运算能力上的新方向。
items.why_en: Fully offline, on-device transcription keeps meeting audio local, highlighting a privacy-focused direction for AI note-taking tools.

items.why_zh: 重量级投资方入局，为 DeepSeek 的后续研发与算力扩张提供了资金保障。
items.why_en: Backing from heavyweight investors secures capital for DeepSeek's research and compute expansion.

items.title_zh: 报告：AI 收入需在 2027 年前达 4000 亿至 6000 亿美元，才能避开支出“悬崖”
items.title_en: AI Revenue Must Reach $400 Billion to $600 Billion by 2027 to Avoid a Spending ‘Cliff’
items.summary_zh: 据 Barron's 报道，有测算认为 AI 产业需要在 2027 年前实现 4000 亿至 6000 亿美元的收入，才能支撑当前的资本开支水平，避免出现支出“悬崖”——即投入无法被相应回报覆盖、随后急剧回落的风险。这一测算是把当下对数据中心与算力的巨额投资，与尚未充分兑现的收入前景放在一起衡量，凸显市场对 AI 基建投资回报周期的担忧。
items.summary_en: AI Revenue Must Reach $400 Billion to $600 Billion by 2027 to Avoid a Spending ‘Cliff’ Barron's
items.why_zh: 该测算把巨额 AI 基建投入与尚未验证的收入直接挂钩，是判断本轮 AI 热潮能否持续的关键标尺。
items.why_en: It ties massive AI infrastructure spending to unproven revenue, making it a key test of the boom's sustainability.

items.title_zh: 华为鸿蒙星河互联 App 登陆 Apple Watch 端，可与 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.109 及以上版本手机配对连接
items.title_en: Huawei's HarmonyOS Interconnect App Lands on Apple Watch, Pairs With HarmonyOS 7.0.0.109 and Above
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，苹果 App Store Watch 专区显示，鸿蒙星河互联 App 已正式登陆 Apple Watch 端。 应用介绍页显示， 其支持 Apple Watch 与 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.109 及以上版本华为手机配对连接 ，用户可体验信息流转、查找设备等功能。 参考IT之家此前报道，在 9 月 7 日的 HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2 及全场景新品发布会上，华为终端 BG CEO 何刚宣布，华为鸿蒙星河互联升级， 支持苹果 Apple Watch 智能手表、AirPods 无线耳机 。 据介绍，华为鸿蒙星河互联支持华为手机与 Apple Watch 连接， 可实现消息提醒、来电提醒等功能 ；支持华为手机与 AirPods 连接，可在华为手机的负一屏提供查看耳机的电量等功能。 另外，在 10 月 1 日的华为 Mate 90 系列及全场景新品发布会结束后，鸿蒙星河互联 App 迎来 2.0.0 版本升级，新增双机互联功能，首发适配机型包括 Pura X View、Mate 90 系列、Mate XT 2。
items.summary_en: Huawei's "HarmonyOS Interconnect" app has arrived on Apple Watch, letting the watch pair with Huawei phones running HarmonyOS 7.0.0.109 or later for features such as message and call notifications and device finding. Announced on September 7 as part of a cross-ecosystem upgrade, it also supports AirPods; a 2.0.0 update on October 1 added dual-phone connectivity.
items.why_zh: 华为与苹果生态实现设备互通，显示国产厂商在跨系统互联上进一步打开。
items.why_en: It marks a notable cross-ecosystem bridge between Huawei and Apple devices.

items.title_zh: Epic 借助 AI 修补健康记录系统安全漏洞
items.title_en: Epic Turns To AI To Patch Security Flaws In Health Records System
items.summary_zh: 美国医疗电子病历巨头 Epic 正转向人工智能技术，以修补其健康记录系统中存在的安全漏洞。此举旨在提升医疗数据的安全防护能力，应对日益复杂的网络威胁。Epic 的系统被全美大量医院和诊所使用，其安全性直接影响海量患者隐私数据。目前关于具体技术方案和修复范围的细节尚未完全披露。
items.summary_en: Epic Turns To AI To Patch Security Flaws In Health Records System Urban Milwaukee
items.why_zh: 医疗记录系统安全事关大量患者隐私，AI 修补漏洞或成行业风向标。
items.why_en: Security of health records affects massive patient privacy; AI patching could set an industry precedent.

items.title_zh: Being a Billionaire Is Becoming a Political Liability
items.title_en: Being a Billionaire Is Becoming a Political Liability
items.summary_zh: Being a Billionaire Is Becoming a Political Liability Bloomberg.com
items.summary_en: Bloomberg argues that being a billionaire is increasingly becoming a political liability in the U.S. Wealth can trigger voter distrust and backlash amid rising concerns over inequality and elite politics. This trend may reshape how billionaires engage in politics.
items.why_zh: 财富与政治的关系正在变化，影响富豪参政和公共舆论走向。
items.why_en: The shifting relationship between wealth and politics affects billionaire political engagement and public discourse.

items.title_zh: 长安启源 Q06 新增宁德时代电池选装，纯电里程 602 公里
items.title_en: Changan Qiyuan Q06 Adds CATL Battery Option, 602 km Range
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，据易车报道，10 月 9 日，长安启源 Q06 正式面向 602 智享型、602 越享型车型，推出宁德时代电芯选装包。用户可选择将 66.02 度中创新航 800V 6C 电芯，升级为同容量规格的 66.02 度宁德时代 800V 6C 电芯，选装升级后整车续航里程维持不变。 据介绍，无论是原车标配的中创新航电芯，还是可选装的宁德时代电芯， 均纳入长安自研金钟罩电池包完整体系 ，执行统一的央企严苛品控与安全验证标准，整车性能表现、续航输出以及质保权益完全一致。两套方案同样搭载 800V 碳化硅高压平台、支持 6C 闪充，共享金钟罩电池全套安全防护、长寿命设计，以及首任非营运用户电池终身质保政策。 据IT之家此前报道， 长安启源 Q06 于 9 月 23 日上市 ，提供纯电与增程两种动力选择，官方指导价 13.99-16.99 万元。 车身尺寸方面，启源 Q06 长宽高分别为 4837mm、1970mm、1670mm，轴距达到 2940mm。启源 Q06 车顶搭载激光雷达，将首搭长安天枢领航 Ultra，具备端到端城市领航能力。 新车搭载长安天枢座舱 2.0，配备双 TC399 芯片，搭载天枢智能体“小安”。其车内配备大尺寸悬浮式中控屏、全液晶仪表、大尺寸 HUD 以及三辐式多功能方向盘。此外，新车还搭载 15.6 英寸后排娱乐屏、后排小桌板、后排电动…
items.summary_en: Changan Qiyuan Q06 now offers a CATL battery cell option for its 602 Smart and 602 Premium trims starting Oct 9. Owners can upgrade from the standard 66.02 kWh CALB 800V 6C cells to CATL 800V 6C cells of the same capacity, with range unchanged. Both options fall under Changan's self-developed battery pack system with unified quality and safety standards, and share 800V SiC platform, 6C fast charging, and lifetime battery warranty for first non-commercial owners. The Q06 launched Sept 23 at 139,900–169,900 yuan.
items.why_zh: 电池供应商多元化可增强供应链韧性，为消费者提供更多选择。
items.why_en: Diversifying battery suppliers can enhance supply chain resilience and offer consumers more choices.

items.title_zh: Judge dismisses US agency worker's lawsuit, citing AI hallmarks
items.title_en: Judge Dismisses US Agency Worker's Lawsuit, Citing AI Hallmarks
items.summary_zh: Judge dismisses US agency worker's lawsuit, citing AI hallmarks Reuters
items.summary_en: A U.S. judge dismissed a lawsuit filed by a government agency worker, citing hallmarks of AI-generated content in the filing. The judge pointed to signs that the document may have been produced by AI without adequate human verification. The case highlights risks of AI-generated content in legal proceedings.
items.why_zh: AI 生成内容进入法庭文件引发司法关注，可能影响诉讼可信度。
items.why_en: AI-generated content entering court filings raises judicial concerns and may affect litigation credibility.

items.title_zh: KONST 获 3000 万美元 B 轮融资，威刚科技领投
items.title_en: KONST Raises $30M Series B funding Led by ADATA Technology to Scale Up AI Data Center Buildout in Asia and Advance Its Token Factory Strategy
items.summary_zh: KONST 宣布完成 3000 万美元 B 轮融资，由威刚科技（ADATA Technology）领投。该公司计划利用这笔资金扩大在亚洲的 AI 数据中心建设，并推进其“代币工厂”（Token Factory）战略。此举反映出亚洲地区 AI 基础设施投资持续升温，以及对算力和相关服务的旺盛需求。
items.summary_en: KONST Raises $30M Series B funding Led by ADATA Technology to Scale Up AI Data Center Buildout in Asia and Advance Its Token Factory Strategy PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 亚洲 AI 数据中心建设获资本加持，加速区域算力布局。
items.why_en: Capital injection boosts AI data center construction in Asia, accelerating regional compute infrastructure.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 封禁持续滥用 Claude 模型的行为
items.title_en: Anthropic bans persistent abuse of its Claude AI models
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布禁止对其 Claude AI 模型的持续滥用行为。该公司采取行动打击反复违反使用政策、利用模型进行恶意活动的用户。此举旨在维护 AI 模型的安全使用环境，防止 Claude 被用于生成有害内容或进行违规操作。具体封禁标准和执行细节未在标题中详述。
items.summary_en: Anthropic bans persistent abuse of its Claude AI models Anadolu Ajansı
items.why_zh: AI 公司加强滥用治理，关乎模型安全与行业规范。
items.why_en: AI companies tightening abuse enforcement matters for model safety and industry norms.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出数日后暂停 Claude 创业公司免费福利
items.title_en: Anthropic Pauses Free Claude Startup Perks Days After Launch
items.summary_zh: 据《福布斯》报道，Anthropic 在推出针对创业公司的 Claude 免费使用福利仅数日后，便宣布暂停该计划。此举可能由于需求超出预期或运营调整。该福利原本旨在吸引初创企业采用 Claude AI 模型。暂停决定的具体原因和后续安排尚未明确。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Pauses Free Claude Startup Perks Days After Launch Forbes
items.why_zh: AI 公司面向创业公司的推广策略调整，反映供需与运营挑战。
items.why_en: Adjusting startup outreach strategies reflects supply-demand and operational challenges for AI firms.

items.title_zh: 民主党准备就 AI 监管展开博弈
items.title_en: Democrats prepare to battle over AI regulation
items.summary_zh: 美国民主党人正准备就人工智能监管问题展开内部或跨党派博弈。随着 AI 技术快速发展，如何制定有效且平衡的监管框架成为政治焦点。不同派系可能在监管力度、创新激励和公民权利保护等方面存在分歧。这场辩论将影响美国 AI 政策的未来走向。
items.summary_en: Democrats prepare to battle over AI regulation Transformer | Substack
items.why_zh: AI 监管方向将深刻影响技术发展、产业格局与公众利益。
items.why_en: The direction of AI regulation will profoundly impact technology development, industry landscape, and public interest.

items.title_zh: 豆包新增“生活缴费”功能，逐步建设生活场景下的办事能力
items.title_en: Doubao Adds “Life Payment” Feature, Building Out Everyday Service Capabilities
items.summary_zh: 豆包新增“生活缴费”功能，逐步建设生活场景下的办事能力 搜狐网
items.summary_en: According to Sohu, the AI assistant Doubao has added a “life payment” feature as it gradually builds capabilities to handle everyday tasks. The report gives no further details on supported cities, payment categories, or partners. It reflects the broader shift of AI assistants from chatbots toward service portals that complete real-world chores.
items.why_zh: AI 助手从聊天工具向能实际“办事”的生活服务入口延伸，是争夺用户日常高频场景的关键一步。
items.why_en: AI assistants are moving from chatbots to service portals that handle real-life tasks, a key battleground for everyday user engagement.

items.title_zh: 特朗普试图给 AI“改名”：称其“超级”，把反对者叫作“敌人”
items.title_en: Trump’s attempt to rename AI is looking awfully artificial
items.summary_zh: 文章指出，特朗普正把惯用的语言战术搬到 AI 议题上：一边把他想加速发展的这项技术贴上“超级”（super）标签，一边把“artificial”（人工的）变成新的贬义词，并把反对者称为“敌人”（THE ENEMY）。此前他曾用“小马可”“Crooked Hillary”等绰号攻击对手，还把“fake news”从描述不良媒体的说法变成对整个新闻界的贬称。报道称，一些 AI 界最有名的人物也在附和这套叙事，而文章对这场“改名”运动的成效持怀疑态度。
items.summary_en: President Donald Trump has a knack for turning words against his enemies. His first successful presidential run was built on monikers like "Little Marco" and "Crooked Hillary"; he changed "fake news" from a phrase describing scammy media outlets to a derogatory term for the press at large. Over the past few weeks, he's clearly decided he can work the same magic to promote artificial intelligence - branding a technology he wants to accelerate "super", while turning "artificial" into his latest go-to pejorative and declaring resisters "THE ENEMY." Some of the biggest names in AI are going along…
items.why_zh: 政治话语如何框定 AI，会直接影响公众认知与相关政策的走向。
items.why_en: How politicians frame AI shapes public perception and the direction of AI policy.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布数百个 AI 生成数学证明，数学家愤怒回应
items.title_en: Mathematicians React With Fury as OpenAI Releases Hundreds of New AI-Generated Proofs
items.summary_zh: 据 Futurism 报道，OpenAI 发布了数百个由 AI 生成的数学证明，在数学界引发强烈不满。报道标题显示数学家的反应相当激烈，但现有摘要未提供更多细节，例如这些证明涉及哪些数学问题、是否经过验证、以及 OpenAI 公开发布它们的用意。事件凸显出 AI 大规模介入数学研究时，围绕成果可靠性、验证方式与学术规范的争议。
items.summary_en: Mathematicians React With Fury as OpenAI Releases Hundreds of New AI-Generated Proofs Futurism
items.why_zh: 若 AI 能规模化产出数学证明，将冲击数学研究的验证方式与学术评价体系。
items.why_en: If AI can mass-produce mathematical proofs, it could disrupt how math research is verified and evaluated.

items.title_zh: 曾经最火的 AI 智能体 Instinct，能扛住 Muse 的冲击吗？
items.title_en: Instinct was the buzziest AI agent around — can it survive Muse?
items.summary_zh: Instinct 是一家以 AI 智能体为主打的初创公司，其产品只需一条短信即可调用。今年 8 月，它以颇为另类的方式进入市场：仅限邀请、不做营销、几乎连官网都没有。尽管如此，Instinct 迅速成为 AI 圈最热门的话题之一，凭借直白的短信式交互，以及代订 DMV 预约、发送跟进邮件等办事能力收获好评。随后 Muse 与 Dots 相继登场——它们来自两家实力远为雄厚的公司，产品与 Instinct 大同小异。面对大厂挤压，这家小公司能否守住阵地，成为报道的核心问题。
items.summary_en: Instinct’s agent is always just a text away. Before there were cute little guys , there was Instinct. In August, the startup got its AI agent to market with an unusual playbook: invite-only, no marketing, and barely so much as a website. And yet, Instinct quickly became the buzziest thing in AI, garnering praise for its straightforward, text message-based interface and its ability to handle chores like booking DMV appointments and sending follow-up emails . Then Muse arrived, followed not long after by Dots. The same products, more or less, from two far more powerful companies. With Big Tech p…
items.why_zh: 它浓缩了 AI 智能体赛道的典型困局：小团队靠体验创新抢先，却随时可能被大厂复制碾压。
items.why_en: It captures the classic AI agent dilemma: a small team innovates on experience first, only to be copied by much larger players.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 预计年底前年化收入再增 200 亿美元
items.title_en: OpenAI Projects $20 Billion Jump in Annualized Revenue Before Year End
items.summary_zh: 据 PYMNTS.com 报道，OpenAI 预计在年底之前将其年化收入（annualized revenue）提高约 200 亿美元。报道未披露更多细节，例如当前年化收入的基数、增长主要由哪些业务线贡献，以及实现这一预期所需的条件。若该目标达成，将进一步提升 OpenAI 在生成式 AI 商业化上的领先身位。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Projects $20 Billion Jump in Annualized Revenue Before Year End PYMNTS.com
items.why_zh: 收入规模的跃升直接反映生成式 AI 的商业化速度，也关系到 OpenAI 巨额算力投入能否持续。
items.why_en: The revenue jump is a direct gauge of how fast generative AI is commercializing—and whether OpenAI can sustain its massive compute spending.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 禁止“残忍对待” Claude AI 系统
items.title_en: Anthropic Bans 'Cruel' Treatment of Claude AI Systems
items.summary_zh: 据 The Tech Buzz 报道，Anthropic 出台规定，禁止对其 AI 模型 Claude 进行“残忍”对待。现有摘要未说明该禁令的具体适用范围与执行方式，例如是否写入使用条款、是否针对某类滥用性交互。这一举措把“该如何对待 AI 系统”从纯技术问题推向伦理与规范层面，也与 Anthropic 一贯强调 AI 安全与负责任使用的立场相呼应。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Bans 'Cruel' Treatment of Claude AI Systems The Tech Buzz
items.why_zh: 它提出一个新问题：AI 系统是否应享有某种“对待规范”，这将影响未来 AI 伦理与监管讨论。
items.why_en: It raises a novel question—whether AI systems deserve rules about how they are treated—that could shape future AI ethics and regulation debates.

items.title_zh: 智谱、Meta供应商称高质量语料稀缺性加剧，有公司已受益
items.title_en: Zhipu and Meta Suppliers Say High-Quality Training Data Is Getting Scarcer—and Some Firms Are Already Benefiting
items.summary_zh: 智谱、Meta供应商称高质量语料稀缺性加剧，有公司已受益 证券之星
items.summary_en: Suppliers to Zhipu and Meta say high-quality training data is becoming increasingly scarce, while some companies are already benefiting from controlling such data, according to 证券之星. The report offers few specifics on which suppliers are involved or how large the gains are.
items.why_zh: 当模型能力趋于接近，稀缺的高质量数据可能成为下一阶段大模型竞争的核心壁垒。
items.why_en: As model capabilities converge, scarce high-quality data may become the key moat in the next phase of the LLM race.

items.title_zh: Counterpoint：苹果全新 MacBook Pro 将推动 OLED 笔记本面板市场增长，预计今年市场出货量同比增长 50%
items.title_en: Counterpoint: Apple’s New MacBook Pro to Drive OLED Laptop Panel Shipments Up 50% in 2026
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，市场研究机构 Counterpoint Research 发文，认为苹果触控屏 MacBook Pro 预计将推动 OLED 笔记本电脑面板市场增长。预计 2026 年 OLED 笔记本面板出货量将同比增长 50%，2027 年还将进一步增长 24%。 在高端笔记本显示面板市场中，Counterpoint 预计 OLED 面板相对于 Mini LED 面板将进一步扩大领先优势。预计 OLED 面板在该市场的出货占比将从 2025 年的 56% 升至 2026 年的 75%，Mini LED 面板的占比则将从 44% 降至 25%。 除苹果产品换代外，高端 AI PC 需求持续增长，以及 OLED 面板技术和制造工艺的进步，也进一步推动 OLED 面板市场扩张。 展望未来，Counterpoint Research 预计 2024 年至 2030 年 OLED 笔记本面板出货量的复合年增长率将达到 26%，面板收入的复合年增长率则有望达到 35%。随着苹果带动厂商逐步将 OLED 引入高端笔记本产品，相应技术面板在笔记本电脑市场中的占比预计还将继续提升。
items.summary_en: Counterpoint Research expects Apple’s new touchscreen MacBook Pro to accelerate growth in the OLED laptop panel market, forecasting a 50% year-over-year rise in OLED notebook panel shipments in 2026 and another 24% in 2027. OLED’s share of the premium laptop display market is projected to climb from 56% in 2025 to 75% in 2026, while Mini LED falls from 44% to 25%. Growing premium AI PC demand and OLED manufacturing advances are also driving the shift.
items.why_zh: 苹果的采用往往定义供应链方向，OLED 取代 Mini LED 的节奏将牵动整个笔记本面板产业格局。
items.why_en: Apple’s adoption typically sets supply-chain direction, so the OLED-versus-Mini LED shift will reshape the laptop display industry.

items.title_zh: 豆包灰度测试缴纳水费、电费、燃气费？回应来了
items.title_en: ByteDance's Doubao Reportedly Tests Utility Bill Payments in Gray-Scale Trial
items.summary_zh: 豆包灰度测试缴纳水费、电费、燃气费？回应来了 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Reports say ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao is running a gray-scale test of utility bill payment features covering water, electricity and gas, drawing attention to how far AI apps are moving into daily services. Doubao has responded to the reports, though scope and rollout details remain unclear.
items.why_zh: 若 AI 助手接入生活缴费，意味着大模型应用正从问答工具向高频生活服务入口延伸。
items.why_en: If AI assistants handle utility payments, it signals chatbots are moving from Q&A tools toward everyday service gateways.

items.title_zh: Bradley Tusk 评 Anthropic IPO：安全优先为何还要上市？
items.title_en: Bradley Tusk on Anthropic IPO: Why add public market pressure if safety is your top priority?
items.summary_zh: 在 CNBC 的节目中，风险投资人、政治顾问 Bradley Tusk 就 Anthropic 潜在的 IPO 发表看法，质疑这家以 AI 安全为核心使命的公司为何要走向公开市场。他提出，如果安全是公司的首要任务，上市带来的业绩与股东压力可能与之相冲突。Anthropic 是 Claude 系列模型的开发商，其上市动向近来备受关注。
items.summary_en: Bradley Tusk on Anthropic IPO: Why add public market pressure if safety is your top priority? CNBC
items.why_zh: 围绕 Anthropic 上市的争论，折射出 AI 安全使命与资本市场逻辑之间的根本张力。
items.why_en: The Anthropic IPO debate exposes the fundamental tension between AI safety missions and capital-market incentives.

items.title_zh: 报告：中国 AI 开发者仅对 3.6% 的模型发布公开安全测试
items.title_en: China AI developers publish safety tests for just 3.6% of model releases, report finds
items.summary_zh: 路透社报道，一份最新报告发现，中国 AI 开发者在发布模型时，仅对其中 3.6% 的发布版本公开了安全测试结果。这一比例远低于外界对 AI 安全透明度的期待，凸显出行业在模型风险评估信息公开方面存在明显缺口。报告由此呼吁开发者提高安全测试的披露水平。
items.summary_en: China AI developers publish safety tests for just 3.6% of model releases, report finds Reuters
items.why_zh: 安全测试披露率过低，意味着外界难以评估模型风险，监管与公众监督都缺乏依据。
items.why_en: Such a low disclosure rate leaves regulators and the public without a basis to assess model risks.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 禁止对 Claude 施虐，背后原因值得警惕
items.title_en: Anthropic Just Banned Being Cruel to Claude. The Reason Should Concern Us All
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 更新了使用政策，明确禁止用户对 Claude 进行“残忍”或恶意的对待。Inc.com 的报道认为，这一看似细小的规则变化背后有更深层的原因，值得所有人关注。文章指出，这一规定指向 Anthropic 对模型行为与“模型福祉”的一贯立场，也引发关于我们该如何对待 AI 系统、以及这种态度会如何反过来影响人类自身的讨论。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Just Banned Being Cruel to Claude. The Reason Should Concern Us All Inc.com
items.why_zh: 把“虐待 AI”写入禁令，标志着头部厂商开始将模型福祉纳入规范，也可能重塑人机互动伦理。
items.why_en: Writing "AI abuse" into a policy marks a shift toward treating model welfare as a governance issue with wider ethical implications.

items.title_zh: 字节豆包上架华为鸿蒙PC，国产操作系统补齐AI入口
items.title_en: ByteDance's Doubao Lands on Huawei HarmonyOS PC, Filling the AI Entry Point for a Homegrown OS
items.summary_zh: 字节豆包上架华为鸿蒙PC，国产操作系统补齐AI入口 集微网
items.summary_en: ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao is now available on Huawei's HarmonyOS PC platform. The move fills a key AI entry point for China's homegrown operating system and strengthens the HarmonyOS PC ecosystem.
items.why_zh: 主流 AI 助手登陆鸿蒙 PC，是国产操作系统补齐 AI 生态、参与竞争的关键一步。
items.why_en: Bringing a mainstream AI assistant to HarmonyOS PC is a key step in building a domestic AI software ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 【视频】豆包座舱+Momenta R7，13.78万起订，家越07凭啥2周狂揽3万订单？
items.title_en: Doubao Cockpit Plus Momenta R7: JIAYUE 07 Takes 30,000 Orders in Two Weeks From ¥137,800
items.summary_zh: 【视频】豆包座舱+Momenta R7，13.78万起订，家越07凭啥2周狂揽3万订单？ 汽车之家
items.summary_en: According to Autohome, the JIAYUE 07 — featuring the Doubao smart cockpit and Momenta R7 — has drawn about 30,000 orders in two weeks, starting at ¥137,800. A video breaks down what drives its appeal.
items.why_zh: AI 座舱与智驾方案正成为新车核心卖点，订单表现显示消费者对智能化配置的买单意愿。
items.why_en: AI cockpits and assisted driving are becoming core selling points, and the order numbers show buyers are responding.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 要禁止滥用聊天机器人，业内人士怎么看
items.title_en: Anthropic Wants to Ban Chatbot Abuse: What Smart People Are Saying
items.summary_zh: Business Insider 汇总了业界人士对 Anthropic 拟禁止“滥用聊天机器人”这一做法的看法。Anthropic 主张对恶意、残忍地对待 Claude 的行为加以限制，多位观察者就此展开讨论，观点涉及模型行为规范、AI 福祉以及这类规则是否合理可行等层面，反映出 AI 安全治理正在进入更细分的议题。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Wants to Ban Chatbot Abuse: What Smart People Are Saying Business Insider
items.why_zh: 业界对“禁止滥用 AI”的分歧，说明模型行为规范正从技术问题演变为公共治理议题。
items.why_en: The split reactions show norms for AI model behavior are becoming a public governance question, not just a technical one.

items.title_zh: 2027 款深蓝 L06 及追风版正式上市，售价 11.49 万元起
items.title_en: 2027 Deepal L06 and Track Edition Launched, Starting at ¥114,900
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，10 月 9 日，深蓝汽车正式推出 2027 款深蓝 L06 及深蓝 L06 追风版。其中，2027 款限时权益价 11.49 万元起，深蓝 L06 追风版 15.19 万元起，下订即享至高价值 62758 元的 12 重大超值购车权益。 据官方介绍，新车围绕操控、智能辅助驾驶、智能座舱及舒适性进行升级，追风版则采用专属赛道化空气动力学套件，进一步强化运动属性。 操控方面，2027 款深蓝 L06 搭载升级后的磁流变悬架，通过采用低粘度磁流变液及微米级珩磨工艺，进一步提升悬架响应速度和细碎振动过滤表现。官方称，该悬架每秒可进行 1000 次阻尼动态调节，响应速度是 CDC 悬架的 20 倍，阻尼调节范围为 CDC 悬架的 6 倍。 配置方面，磁流变悬架覆盖 2027 款深蓝 L06 Ultra 版、Ultra+ 版及追风版。此外，两款新车均配备爆胎稳行系统，官方称可支持车辆在时速 200 公里时爆胎后保持稳定行驶。 智能辅助驾驶方面，2027 款深蓝 L06 搭载天枢领航辅助驾驶系统，引入世界模型与强化学习技术。除 MAX 版本外，新车全系配备 1 颗激光雷达、3 颗毫米波雷达等感知硬件，并搭载两颗地平线 J6M 芯片，算力为 256 TOPS。系统支持城区及高速领航辅助、自动泊车等功能，并引入城市自主漫游功能，可在无需预设目的地的情况下，根据当前道…
items.summary_en: Deepal has launched the 2027 L06 and L06 Track Edition, priced from ¥114,900 (limited-time) and ¥151,900, with up to ¥62,758 in booking perks. Upgrades include a magnetorheological suspension with 1,000 damping adjustments per second, plus a Tianshu driver-assistance system using world-model and reinforcement-learning techniques, powered by two Horizon J6M chips with 256 TOPS.
items.why_zh: 磁流变悬架与引入世界模型、强化学习的智驾系统下放到十万元级车型，显示智能驾驶配置正加速普及。
items.why_en: Putting magnetorheological suspension and world-model-based driver assistance into a roughly ¥115,000 car shows advanced features moving rapidly downmarket.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 仍预计 2026 年底年化收入达 700 亿美元
items.title_en: OpenAI is still projecting $70 billion in annualized revenue by end of 2026
items.summary_zh: 据 Quartz 报道，OpenAI 依然维持其此前给出的收入预期，即到 2026 年底实现约 700 亿美元的年化收入。这一数字反映的是按当前收入水平外推的年度规模，而非已实现的全年营收，但足以显示该公司对自身商业化增速的信心。在算力投入巨大、行业对 AI 盈利前景争论不断的背景下，这一目标能否达成将直接影响市场对头部大模型公司的估值判断。
items.summary_en: OpenAI is still projecting $70 billion in annualized revenue by end of 2026 Quartz
items.why_zh: 700 亿美元年化收入目标关乎市场对 OpenAI 乃至整个大模型行业盈利能力的信心。
items.why_en: The $70 billion annualized revenue target shapes market confidence in OpenAI's — and the broader LLM industry's — ability to monetize.

items.title_zh: 懂车帝：网传内部整顿通知截图系 AI 生成，相关信息均为谣言
items.title_en: Dongchedi Denies Internal Reorganization Notice, Says Screenshot Was AI-Generated
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，据懂车帝企业辟谣官方账号，一张所谓以“懂车帝科技有限公司人力资源部”名义发布的内部整顿通知截图在网上流传。官方声明称：“该截图系 AI 生成，相关信息均为谣言，不排除有引导舆论的可能，请大家不信谣、不传谣。” IT之家附懂车帝辟谣声明原文如下： 我们注意到，一张所谓以“懂车帝科技有限公司人力资源部”名义发布的内部整顿通知截图在网上流传。我们在此声明： 该截图系 AI 生成，相关信息均为谣言，不排除有引导舆论的可能，请大家不信谣、不传谣 。同时，懂车帝将核实谣言来源，坚决采取法律措施维护公司合法权益。 此外，懂车帝法务部转发了相关内容，并郑重声明： 懂车帝法务部郑重声明：制作、发布、传播该虚假《内部整顿通知》的行为已严重侵害懂车帝的名誉权、商标权，并涉嫌构成刑事犯罪。懂车帝正全面核实谣言来源，固定相关证据，坚决采取一切必要法律手段，包括但不限于向公安机关报案、向网信部门举报、提起民事侵权诉讼乃至刑事控告， 坚决追究造谣者、恶意传播者的全部法律责任 ，绝不姑息。
items.summary_en: Dongchedi said a widely circulated screenshot of an alleged internal reorganization notice from its HR department was AI-generated and is entirely false. Its legal department warned that creating and spreading the fake notice infringes its reputation and trademark rights and may constitute a crime, vowing to pursue legal action.
items.why_zh: 这是 AI 生成内容被用于伪造企业公文、制造谣言的又一案例，凸显生成式 AI 带来的信息真实性风险与法律追责问题。
items.why_en: It is another case of AI-generated content being used to fabricate corporate documents, highlighting the disinformation and legal risks of generative AI.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出面向开源软件的免费漏洞检测服务
items.title_en: Anthropic Now Offers A Free Vulnerability-Finding Service For Open-Source Software
items.summary_zh: 据 Engadget 报道，Anthropic 宣布为开源软件提供免费的漏洞发现服务。该举措将 AI 能力用于安全领域，帮助开源项目识别潜在安全缺陷，而开源组件被广泛应用于各类商业与基础设施系统中。此举既有助于提升开源生态的整体安全性，也可视为 Anthropic 在 AI 安全叙事与开发者生态建设上的进一步布局。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Now Offers A Free Vulnerability-Finding Service For Open-Source Software Engadget
items.why_zh: 开源软件是互联网基础设施的底座，用 AI 免费为其找漏洞，有望提升整个软件生态的安全性。
items.why_en: Open-source code underpins the internet, so free AI-powered vulnerability detection could meaningfully improve ecosystem-wide security.

items.title_zh: UX 周报：AI 主题分析、Nano Banana 2.1、滚动交互与 AI 技能瓶颈
items.title_en: UX Roundup: Erik the Red | AI Thematic Analysis | Nano Banana 2.1 | Scrolling | Fast Asymptote in AI Skills | Average Users | Wishlists | Usability Testing Without Findings | Naming Consistency
items.summary_zh: Jakob Nielsen 的 UX 周报汇总了近期用户体验与 AI 交叉领域的多个话题，包括“Erik the Red”、AI 主题分析、Nano Banana 2.1、页面滚动、AI 技能增长的“快速渐近线”、普通用户、心愿单、无发现结果的可用性测试以及命名一致性等。该周报以短评形式覆盖设计实践、AI 工具进展与用户研究方法等多个方向，供从业者快速了解行业动态。
items.summary_en: UX Roundup: Erik the Red | AI Thematic Analysis | Nano Banana 2.1 | Scrolling | Fast Asymptote in AI Skills | Average Users | Wishlists | Usability Testing Without Findings | Naming Consistency Jakob Nielsen on UX
items.why_zh: 该周报集中呈现了 AI 工具与用户体验设计、研究方法交汇的最新讨论，对产品与设计从业者有参考价值。
items.why_en: The roundup captures current debates at the intersection of AI tools, UX design, and research methods, useful for product and design practitioners.

items.title_zh: 报道称 OpenAI 收入比预期低 200 亿美元，英伟达市值蒸发 1700 亿美元
items.title_en: OpenAI’s Revenue Is Reportedly $20 Billion Lower Than Thought. Nvidia Just Lost $170 Billion
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance 报道，有消息称 OpenAI 的收入比外界此前认为的低约 200 亿美元，受此影响，英伟达市值一度蒸发约 1700 亿美元。这一消息将市场对 AI 商业化进度的担忧直接传导至算力产业链，凸显 AI 芯片需求预期与模型厂商实际收入之间的紧密关联。报道并未给出更详细的收入口径或时间范围。
items.summary_en: OpenAI’s Revenue Is Reportedly $20 Billion Lower Than Thought. Nvidia Just Lost $170 Billion Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 它显示 AI 模型公司的实际收入预期可能直接冲击英伟达等算力厂商的估值，反映市场对 AI 变现节奏的敏感。
items.why_en: It shows how expectations for AI model makers' revenue can directly swing the valuation of compute players like Nvidia, reflecting market sensitivity to AI monetization.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek拟人形象“罗生门”，我们查了个明白
items.title_en: Untangling the 'Rashomon' Around DeepSeek's Anthropomorphic Persona
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek拟人形象“罗生门”，我们查了个明白 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: An article from Sina Mobile digs into the 'Rashomon'-style dispute over DeepSeek's anthropomorphic persona, sorting through conflicting accounts to clarify what actually happened. The piece examines the competing versions of the story surrounding the company's brand image and personification.
items.why_zh: 涉及中国头部大模型公司 DeepSeek 的品牌形象争议，厘清事实有助于理解其公众传播与舆情管理。
items.why_en: The dispute concerns the brand image of leading Chinese LLM company DeepSeek, making fact-checking relevant to its public communication and reputation management.

items.title_zh: 有消息称，DeepSeek年化收入或已达到10亿美元
items.title_en: Report: DeepSeek's Annualized Revenue May Have Reached $1 Billion
items.summary_zh: 有消息称，DeepSeek年化收入或已达到10亿美元 三易生活
items.summary_en: According to a report from 三易生活, DeepSeek's annualized revenue may have reached $1 billion. If accurate, that would place it among the few LLM companies with meaningful scale, though the claim remains unverified and details such as revenue mix and methodology were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 若属实，10 亿美元年化收入将标志中国大模型公司商业化的重要节点，但目前仍属未经证实的传闻。
items.why_en: If true, $1 billion in annualized revenue would mark a milestone for Chinese LLM commercialization, though the claim remains unconfirmed.

items.title_zh: 美团：将提高超重、体积大、步行上下楼等较难配送订单计费权重
items.title_en: Meituan to Raise Pay Weights for Hard-to-Deliver Orders Such as Heavy, Bulky, and Walk-Up Deliveries
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，据国是直通车今日报道，2026 年度美团劳动规则和算法协商恳谈会近日在北京召开。来自全国各地的一线骑手代表与美团平台围绕 劳动报酬、派单规则、休息休假、劳动保护 等议题开展协商，现场签署《2026 年度美团劳动规则和算法协商协议》。 协议明确，美团将提高 超重、体积大、步行上下楼 等较难配送订单的计费权重，增加特殊天气下的收入报酬；继续执行“取消超时扣款”，持续优化顺路派单、配送时限、商家出餐时间预估等机制；逐步扩大“红灯停表”试点；推动养老保险补贴政策落地，减轻骑手参保负担等。 中央多部门相关负责人及专家学者代表到会指导。下一步，各方将跟进协议落实情况，通过常态化沟通和协商，推动骑手意见转化为具体的规则改进。 IT之家注意到，美团今年 7 月正式上线送外卖“等灯停表”功能，预计年内覆盖超百万骑手。当骑手在交通路口等红灯时，页面呈现红灯倒计时读秒信息，美团骑手 AI 安全助手发布提示信息“红灯停一停，正在记录等灯时长，订单结束时将延长本单配送时间”。此外，美团已经取消超时罚款。
items.summary_en: Meituan signed a 2026 agreement with rider representatives in Beijing, pledging higher pay weights for difficult deliveries such as overweight, bulky, and walk-up orders, plus better pay in bad weather. It will keep scrapping overtime fines, optimize dispatch and delivery-time estimates, expand its 'stop the clock at red lights' pilot, and push forward pension subsidies for riders.
items.why_zh: 这项协议关系到数百万骑手的收入与劳动保障，是平台算法与劳动规则协商机制的标志性进展。
items.why_en: The agreement affects the income and protections of millions of delivery riders and marks notable progress in platform algorithm and labor-rule negotiations.

items.title_zh: Kimi概念板块10月9日涨2.47%，华策影视领涨，主力资金净流入4.67亿元

items.summary_en: On October 9, the Kimi concept sector rose 2.47%, with Huace Film & TV leading the gains, according to Sohu. Main funds recorded a net inflow of 467 million yuan. No further details on individual stocks were disclosed.
items.why_zh: 反映资本市场对Kimi相关AI概念的短期情绪与资金动向。
items.why_en: It reflects short-term market sentiment and capital flows around the Kimi-related AI concept.

items.title_zh: 豆包工作上线任务画布功能并集成Seedream 5.0 Flash模型
items.title_en: Doubao Work launches task canvas and integrates Seedream 5.0 Flash model
items.summary_zh: 豆包工作上线任务画布功能并集成Seedream 5.0 Flash模型 DoNews
items.summary_en: Doubao Work has launched a task canvas feature and integrated the Seedream 5.0 Flash model, according to DoNews. The update combines canvas-based task management with new model capabilities. Specific features and performance details were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 显示AI办公工具正通过画布交互与模型升级提升任务协作和生成效率。
items.why_en: It shows AI productivity tools are enhancing task collaboration and generation through canvas interfaces and model upgrades.

items.title_zh: 报道称Anthropic IPO文件显示去年亏损超400亿美元
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO docs reportedly reveal over $40 billion in losses last year
items.summary_zh: 据Mashable报道，Anthropic的IPO相关文件显示，该公司去年亏损超过400亿美元。报道未披露亏损的具体构成、营收规模或上市时间表。若该数字属实，将凸显头部AI大模型公司在算力、人才与研发上的巨额投入压力。该消息也引发外界对AI公司盈利路径和上市前景的关注。目前Anthropic方面未有更多财务数据公开。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO docs reportedly reveal over $40 billion in losses last year Mashable
